about: Random calendars with a week, and what the npm SDK answers for each: formatStep of three steps, parseDate of each formatted text, and parseDate of three texts with a random weekday name and of one bare word. The calendars come from a seeded generator (seed 20261128): 1 to 4 months of 3 to 12 days, a week of 1 to 4 names whose count may differ from its length by one, free or nested, an era and an intercalary day at random, and one of four formats. Each case's "npm" is its answers in order: per step the formatted text then its parse, then the parse of each input.
